services.name: Sunset Sail
services.desc: Our sunset cruise / sunset sail begins out of the historic Schooner Wharf bar in Old Key West. As we sail out of Man O' War harbor, we'll pass Sunset Isle, Mallory Square, Fort Zachary Taylor, Key West beaches. You might see dolphins, sea turtles, and other marine life. Join the crew in sailing the ship, or relax and enjoy delicious hors d'oeuvres, very nice wines and beer's, mimosa's, and champagne are all included with your cruise. Mimosa's, incredible merlots and pinot grigios, assorted beers, focaccia sandwiches from Duettos restaurant Sandwiches purchased daily for passengers already

blurb: Guests sail aboard the historic Spirit of Independence schooner in Key West. Activities include private charters for groups, sunset sails with complimentary drinks and snacks, and special event cruises such as weddings and scouting voyages. The schooner offers a classic sailing experience with spacious decks and a friendly crew.

quotes.text: Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. Absolutely stunning sunset cruise! We had a wonderful time out on the water. The views were breathtaking, and the boat wasn't crowded, which made the experience feel very relaxed and personal. Diana was incredibly friendly and welcoming, but the real highlights for us were the two dogs—especially Baba, the little Chihuahua. He was the star of the show! Highly recommend this for a peaceful evening.

Thanks for another great sunset cruise! We have been on six sunset cruises with Captain Ricky and crew. Enjoy a nice relaxing cruise with free wine, beer, champagne and mimosas. We had approximately 20 people on board so we had plenty of room to relax and visit with other on board and the crew. As we sailed around a watched the sunset we enjoyed some nice music.
Great sunset cruise for my wife and I! Highly recommend for anyone in Key West looking for an easy going cruise. Food was awesome and the crew was even better. Super friendly and pleasant.
